subject.title: fix(talk): realtime Talk speaks a no-text placeholder before the real answer

question: Should realtime Talk expose `talk.realtime.emptyFinalGraceMs` as a permanent user and Gateway configuration contract, or should this bug fix remain an internal default-only behavior change?
rationale: The repository policy sets a high bar for new config surfaces, while the supplied patch shows the reported race can be addressed by changing the existing internal fallback timing.

options.title: Keep the fix internal
options.body: Use the 60-second internal default and remove the new schema, protocol, docs, UI config-read, and transport-context plumbing.

options.title: Approve the public setting
options.body: Retain the option only with explicit ownership of its upgrade behavior, documentation, protocol contract, and reason operators need the zero/immediate fallback.

recommendation.title: Keep the fix internal
recommendation.body: Use the 60-second internal default and remove the new schema, protocol, docs, UI config-read, and transport-context plumbing.

likelyOwner.reason: The needed decision owns realtime Talk behavior and its exposed configuration contract; local history routing was unavailable.
